cases.name: anomaly-flag-conditional-memory
cases.description: A <gen> with if= mints its anomaly_flag column. anomaly_factor=1000 against a 1..3 draw makes the spike unmistakable, so the flag is checked against the value it claims to describe, not merely for being a boolean.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Class"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" value="1..3" anomaly="0.4" anomaly_factor="1000" anomaly_flag="Flag" if="Class == a"/><gen type="number" value="1..3" anomaly="0.4" anomaly_factor="1000" anomaly_flag="Flag"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Class}}|${{V}}|${{Flag}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: anomaly-flag-conditional-disk
cases.description: The same config on the streaming engine, expecting the SAME rows. This is the case that was missing: a branch used to draw off the run's shared PRNG in memory and off its own stream when streaming, so the two engines disagreed and nothing noticed. Byte-identical to anomaly-flag-conditional-memory by design — if you re-baseline one, re-baseline both together or the pair stops testing anything.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="disk"><sequence name="Class"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" value="1..3" anomaly="0.4" anomaly_factor="1000" anomaly_flag="Flag" if="Class == a"/><gen type="number" value="1..3" anomaly="0.4" anomaly_factor="1000" anomaly_flag="Flag"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Class}}|${{V}}|${{Flag}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: anomaly-flag-conditional-unflagged-branch
cases.description: Only the first branch can spike. Rows from the second are still COVERED by the sequence, so the flag reads false rather than empty — a detector scored against the column needs "no outlier" stated, not left blank. Values 7..9 mark those rows plainly.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Class"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" value="1..3" anomaly="0.4" anomaly_factor="1000" anomaly_flag="Flag" if="Class == a"/><gen type="number" value="7..9"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Class}}|${{V}}|${{Flag}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-spike-keeps-the-columns-shape
cases.description: A spike used to be multiplied and re-stringified, which threw away the zero padding length= asked for and the decimal places decimals= asked for — so the outlier rows were the only ones in the file with a different shape: 00014 then 117, 85.66 then 6.445. An outlier is far from the others in VALUE, not in format.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="s7" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Z"><gen type="number" value="1..99" length="5" anomaly="0.4" anomaly_factor="3"/></sequence><sequence name="D"><gen type="number" value="1..99" decimals="2" anomaly="0.4" anomaly_factor="0.5"/></sequence><sequence name="P"><gen type="number" value="10..99" anomaly="0.4" anomaly_factor="10"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Z}} ${{D}} ${{P}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-blanked-cell-carries-no-label
cases.description: anomaly_flag is the ground truth an outlier detector is scored against, and the anomalies page promises the flag and the spike can never disagree. A cell missing= blanked has no spike to agree with, so the label is false there. This is the pairing that page explicitly recommends, and it wrote true beside an empty cell until the flag learned to follow the outcome.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="12" seed="af" local="en"><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" value="40..60" anomaly="0.5" anomaly_factor="10" anomaly_flag="IsOut" missing="0.5" missing_as="NULL"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}} ${{IsOut}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-blanked-cell-carries-no-label-inline
cases.description: The same rule for a generator built INLINE rather than drawn. Those types never route through the per-row builder, so on the streaming engines their anomaly_flag column has to be attached explicitly — four ports attached nothing at all, and ${{IsOut}} reached the output as its own literal text.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="12" seed="afi" local="en"><sequence name="V"><gen type="timeseries" base="100" trend="1" noise="0.1" anomaly="0.5" anomaly_factor="10" anomaly_flag="IsOut" missing="0.5" missing_as="NULL"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}} ${{IsOut}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: missing-mar-another-column
cases.description: MAR: the condition reads ANOTHER column — every covered row is blank, every other row intact
cases.config:
<tdc><env count="12" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Age"><gen type="number" value="18..60"/></sequence>
    <sequence name="Inc"><gen type="number" value="100..999" missing="1" missing_when="Age < 45"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Age}},[${{Inc}}]</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: missing-mar-partial-rate
cases.description: The rate still applies inside the condition: a covered row may survive, an uncovered one never blanks
cases.config:
<tdc><env count="12" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Age"><gen type="number" value="18..60"/></sequence>
    <sequence name="Inc"><gen type="number" value="100..999" missing="0.5" missing_when="Age < 45"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Age}},[${{Inc}}]</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: missing-mnar-the-value-itself
cases.description: MNAR: the condition reads _value, so which rows vanish depends on what they held
cases.config: <tdc><env count="12" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Inc"><gen type="number" value="100..999" missing="1" missing_when="_value > 500"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>[${{Inc}}]</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: missing-when-covers-nothing
cases.description: A condition no row satisfies blanks nothing, even at missing="1"
cases.config:
<tdc><env count="12" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Age"><gen type="number" value="18..60"/></sequence>
    <sequence name="Inc"><gen type="number" value="100..999" missing="1" missing_when="Age > 999"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Age}},[${{Inc}}]</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: missing-when-with-token
cases.description: missing_as spells the hole; missing_when decides which rows get one
cases.config:
<tdc><env count="12" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Age"><gen type="number" value="18..60"/></sequence>
    <sequence name="Inc"><gen type="number" value="100..999" missing="1" missing_when="Age < 40" missing_as="NULL"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Age}},${{Inc}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: missing-when-on-inline-types-memory
cases.description: The types the streaming engine builds INLINE — a timeseries, a counter — take their blanking draw off a keyed #miss stream rather than the generator's own, and that path used to skip the condition entirely: every cell came out blank. MAR from another column and MNAR from the value itself, on one row set, so a port that honours one and not the other fails here.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="10" seed="mar-inline" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Age"><gen type="number" value="18..60"/></sequence><sequence name="TS"><gen type="timeseries" base="100" trend="1" noise="0" missing="1" missing_as="NA" missing_when="Age > 40"/></sequence><sequence name="Seen"><gen type="increment" step="1" missing="1" missing_as="NA" missing_when="_value > 4"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Age}},${{TS}},${{Seen}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: missing-when-on-inline-types-stream
cases.description: The same config on the streaming engine, expecting the SAME rows. This is the pair that caught it: the in-memory engine honoured missing_when= and the streaming one blanked every row, from one seed. Byte-identical to missing-when-on-inline-types-memory by design — if you re-baseline one, re-baseline both together or the pair stops testing anything.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="10" seed="mar-inline" local="en" mode="disk"><sequence name="Age"><gen type="number" value="18..60"/></sequence><sequence name="TS"><gen type="timeseries" base="100" trend="1" noise="0" missing="1" missing_as="NA" missing_when="Age > 40"/></sequence><sequence name="Seen"><gen type="increment" step="1" missing="1" missing_as="NA" missing_when="_value > 4"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Age}},${{TS}},${{Seen}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: missing-when-and-anomaly-flag-memory
cases.description: anomaly_flag beside a CONDITIONAL missing=. The flag has to read the same condition as the value, or it says false on every row the condition excludes — rows that were never blanked and whose spike is still there. The condition also reads the value AFTER the spike, which is what `_value` means to the blanking pass.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="12" seed="mar-flag" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Age"><gen type="number" value="18..60"/></sequence><sequence name="TS"><gen type="timeseries" base="100" trend="1" noise="0.2" anomaly="0.5" anomaly_factor="10" anomaly_flag="IsOut" missing="1" missing_as="NA" missing_when="Age > 40"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Age}},${{TS}},${{IsOut}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: missing-when-and-anomaly-flag-stream
cases.description: The same config streamed. Byte-identical to missing-when-and-anomaly-flag-memory by design — re-baseline both together or the pair stops testing anything.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="12" seed="mar-flag" local="en" mode="disk"><sequence name="Age"><gen type="number" value="18..60"/></sequence><sequence name="TS"><gen type="timeseries" base="100" trend="1" noise="0.2" anomaly="0.5" anomaly_factor="10" anomaly_flag="IsOut" missing="1" missing_as="NA" missing_when="Age > 40"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Age}},${{TS}},${{IsOut}}</data></line></block></tdc>
